result.brief: 提出 Instruct-to-Act，将 VLM 规划器与语言可指令的世界模型控制器解耦，通过合成指令重标注与行为克隆联合训练，实现高频具身控制。
result.reason: Trains a world-model controller conditioned on VLM text instructions for embodied control; world modeling is central, but contribution is policy/control rather than representation or foundation world model.
